ED Arrests Chhattisgarh Officials in Paper Leak and Commission Probe

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has made two arrests in connection with alleged paper leak rackets and a commission trail in Chhattisgarh. The ED arrested an individual identified as a relative of former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel's ex-private secretary. The agency alleges a Rs 3 crore paper leak racket and a Rs 31 crore commission trail. Another arrest was made in connection with the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) probe. The ED claims a Rs 2.8 crore money trail related to the paper leak scam.
